text.zh: 画出防波堤末端一盏守夜灯。
text.en: Depict a single night-watch light at the end of a breakwater.

text.zh: 场景是细雨与海雾中的夜间港口。
text.en: Set it in a night harbor in light rain and sea fog.

text.zh: 采用较高的斜俯机位，保留可读的堤体走向。
text.en: Use an elevated oblique view with a legible breakwater direction.

text.zh: 冷灰蓝雨水和雾覆盖大部分画面，少量琥珀暖色集中在防波堤末端的小灯罩。
text.en: Cover most of the image in cool blue-gray rainwater and mist; concentrate the small amber accent on the lamp cover at the end of the breakwater.

text.zh: 小灯罩面向来路的短边连贯清楚，外围雾、水面和堤栏的边缘低反差且断续。
text.en: Keep the lamp-cover edge facing the approach short, continuous, and clear; break up the low-contrast outlines of mist, water, and railing.

text.zh: 刻画灯罩的框和一小段湿边。水面、远栏和近侧堤体只保留低密度色块与必要轮廓。
text.en: Detail the lamp housing and a short wet edge. Keep the water, distant rail, and near breakwater low-density with broad shapes and only essential contours.

text.zh: 从近景堤边的暗斜线沿堤向远处小灯移动，使唯一暖点、清晰边和主要细节在灯罩会合。
text.en: Lead the eye along the dark diagonal near edge of the breakwater to the distant lamp cover, where the only warm accent, clearest edge, and principal detail converge.

text.zh: 大暗色面轻微呈现细纸粒，并保持主视觉细节清楚。
text.en: Let fine paper grain show subtly on broad dark areas, with focal details kept clear.
